sources.title: Guidelines for Completing a Visa Application
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Botswana, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: Live official Botswana Embassy page, directly replayed over valid TLS. It publishes named visa-free and visa-required schedules and directs visa applicants to the official eVisa service, but supplies no effective date or hierarchy over other Botswana authorities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Here is the full list of countries whose citizens do not require a visa to enter Botswana:

sources.title: Countries Requiring Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Live Botswana Tourism Organisation traveller page, directly replayed over valid TLS. It calls its table the list of all countries requiring visas but gives no effective date, legal instrument, or reconciliation with the Embassy's opposite rows.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Below is a list of all the countries that require visas.

sources.title: About Our Country: Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: Current central Government immigration overview, directly replayed over valid TLS. It gives the Commonwealth and bilateral-waiver principles and describes mission and limited border issuance, but does not name any scoped nationality or identify bilateral parties.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign nationals whose countries have signed a Visa Abolition Agreement with Botswana are also not required to apply for a visa.

sources.title: Visa exemption, suppression and facilitation agreements
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Angola / Embassy of Angola in Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Live official MIREX Embassy record names Botswana under a tourism visa-exemption agreement, but is dated 2019 and gives neither ordinary-passport wording nor an affirmative current-force record; it is retained only to explain why Angola cannot be resolved by the contradictory Botswana schedules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: República do Botswana | Acordo de isenção para a concessão de vistos de turismo.
